thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: inference-prod error-rate spike (service=inference-api, env=prod). 5m error_rate = 3.2% (> 0.5% threshold). Pager: @alex_oncall.

alex_oncall: Taking pager. Jumping in now. What region?

marta_sre: Sorry folks — I was on the tail-end of a deploy earlier. This hit in us-east-1 primarily, ~60% of requests. Quick summary: increased 5xxs from model-serving pods (OOMKill-ish) and queue buildup to the fronting API. I left a note in the deploy log.

alex_oncall: Thanks. First step: can someone post the recent deploy id?

marta_sre: Deploy id: deploy-2026-03-15-09-21 (link: https://ci.internal/deploys/2026-03-15-09-21).

chris_platform: I see high memory for model-worker-2/3 on node g4dn-16xlarge. Logs show repeated "out of memory" in python runtime when sequence length spikes.

leo_sre: Paging the autoscaler — looks like replica set didn't scale quickly because of resource quotas. Trying a manual scale: `kubectl scale deploy inference-api --replicas=10 -n prod`

alex_oncall: Doing a quick mitigation: 1) scale to 10, 2) add a fallback route to smaller model (redwood-model-small) for non-critical customers, 3) enable prefix cache. Marta, can you flip the fallback?

marta_sre: On it. Command: `curl -X POST "https://controlplane/api/v1/routes/fallback" -H 'Authorization: Bearer **REDACTED**' -d '{"from":"inference-api","to":"redwood-model-small","percent":30}'` — response 200. Rolling out to traffic.

incident-bot: NOTE: On-call handoff recorded: previous oncall=marta_sre, current_oncall=alex_oncall, note="taking lead, scaling and fallback applied"

alex_oncall: Scaling completed, pods are coming up. Error rate dropped to 1.1% over the last 2m but still higher than baseline.

chris_platform: Added a temporary node pool with looser quotas, draining a few noisy nodes. Also evicted large batch jobs that were using GPUs for offline evals.

nancy_product: Heads-up — a small number of customers reported elevated tail latency in the last 30m. We have a few affected accounts (account ids in support ticket #4523). Nothing major but we should quantify.

leo_sre: Querying metrics: PromQL for error rate I used —
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="inference-api",status=~"5.."}[5m]))
/
sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="inference-api"}[5m]))
```
Current 5m window = 1.05% after mitigation.

alex_oncall: Good. Next: alert tuning and post-incident monitoring. This alert fired hard and woke people up for a transient spike. We should tune to avoid noise but keep customer safety. Proposed: change threshold to 0.8% for 5m and add a secondary alert for sustained spikes (>=0.5% for 15m) that pages only P2. Thoughts?

marta_sre: Agree on two-tier alerts. Also add a low-volume noisy-path suppression: ignore if total request rate < 50 rps to avoid noisy signal on canaries.

chris_platform: +1. Also create a Grafana dashboard for retrospection: we need panels for golden signals (p95 latency, error rate, request rate, saturated pods, queue depth, KV cache hit ratio). Want drilldowns to pod logs and retailer of model variant. I'll spin up a dashboard skeleton in eng-sre/grafana/dashboards/inference-retro.

alex_oncall: Please include a panel for model-serving OOMs (counter of OOMKills) and node memory pressure. For drilldown make the panel links point to Loki queries and to the pod dashboard.

marta_sre: Here's a quick Loki query to link from the error panel that filters by trace id: `| json | status=~"5.." | line_format "{container_name} {message}"` — I'll paste a suggested panel JSON (trimmed) for Grafana: 

```
{
  "title": "Error rate (5m)",
  "type": "graph",
  "targets": [
    {"expr": "sum(rate(http_requests_total{service=\"inference-api\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{service=\"inference-api\"}[5m]))"}
  ],
  "links": [{"title":"Logs","url":"https://grafana.internal/explore?left=~loki"}]
}
```

leo_sre: I'll take the dashboard ownership. Will add panels: p50/p95/p99 latency, request rate, error rate, replica count, OOM kills, KV cache hit rate, queue length, throttled requests. Also create an alert dashboard folder tag `team=eng-sre` and set panel thresholds.

nancy_product: For the customer impact section of the retro, can we get percentage of requests that were served by fallback model vs full model during the incident window? That helps quantify quality regression risk.

chris_platform: We can get that from request metadata — `sum(rate(requests_total{model_variant=\"redwood-model-small\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(requests_total{service=\"inference-api\"}[5m]))`. I ran it: ~28% at peak, back to 4% now.

alex_oncall: Action items to capture here: 
- leo_sre: create the Grafana inference-retro dashboard and add panels/links (owner)
- chris_platform & marta_sre: implement two-tier alert thresholds + rate suppression rule
- leo_sre & platform: add alert runbook link on paging rule and update service page
- product: quantify affected customers and add to postmortem (nancy_product)
- infra: investigate resource quota gating for autoscaler (chris_platform)

marta_sre: I'll also schedule a short live tuning session tomorrow at 11am PST — audit alert noise and runbook clarity.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigation applied. status=stabilized, severity=page.P1 -> monitoring.

alex_oncall: Thanks everyone. I'll hand back to Marta for the rest of the follow-ups. Leaving note in #incidents and creating a post-incident issue in the tracker.

marta_sre: handing back to ops. Thanks all :thumbsup:

leo_sre: Dashboard link (WIP): https://grafana.internal/d/inference-retro/ (I'll post final after panels added)

nancy_product: Pulling the customer list into the postmortem now.

chris_platform: I'll open a ticket for autoscaler quota change and attach node pool logs.

alex_oncall: Closing pager, moving to monitoring-only.

incident-bot: Pager closed (duration 43m).
